## Patterns
| Keyword | Description | Example |
|---------|-------------|---------|
| `trusted-mode` | Queries need a trusted context to verify proofs; `trusted: true` prefetches quorum keys on `connect()` | `const sdk = EvoSDK.testnetTrusted(); await sdk.connect();` |
| `connect-idempotent` | `connect()` is idempotent; facades call `getWasmSdkConnected()` so a forgotten `connect()` is auto-run, but `sdk.wasm` throws before it | `await sdk.connect(); sdk.isConnected` |
| `WithProof-suffix` | Most queries have a `*WithProof` twin returning `ProofMetadataResponseTyped<T>` = `{ data, proof, metadata }` | `const r = await sdk.identities.fetchWithProof(id); r.data; r.proof` |
| `map-response` | `documents.query()`, `getMany`, `balances` return `Map<string, T\|undefined>`; drop misses with a filter | `[...(await sdk.documents.query(q)).values()].filter(Boolean)` |
| `toJSON-conversion` | `Document`/`Identity`/`DataContract` expose `toJSON()` for serialization | `doc.toJSON()` |
| `IdentitySigner` | Identity-signed transitions take `signer`; register keys with `addKey(PrivateKey)` or `addKeyFromWif` | `const signer = new IdentitySigner(); signer.addKeyFromWif(wif);` |
| `identityKey-selection` | Pass the matching `IdentityPublicKey` as `identityKey`: `identity.getPublicKeyById(keyId)` | `const identityKey = identity.getPublicKeyById(2);` |
| `WIF-private-key` | Signing keys are WIF strings; derive with `wallet.deriveKeyFromSeedPhrase` or import with `wallet.keyPairFromWif` | `const { privateKeyWif } = await wallet.deriveKeyFromSeedPhrase({ mnemonic, network: 'testnet' })` |
| `wallet-offline` | `wallet.*` helpers run locally in WASM and need no connection | `await wallet.generateMnemonic({ wordCount: 12 })` |
| `asset-lock-proof` | Identity create/top-up and address funding need an asset lock proof built from the Core tx and its IS-lock | `AssetLockProof.createInstantAssetLockProof(instantLockBytes, txBytes, outputIndex)` |
| `chainlock-fallback` | If the IS-lock never arrives, use a chain-lock proof once the tx is chain-locked | `AssetLockProof.createChainAssetLockProof(coreChainLockedHeight, outPoint)` |
| `devnet-non-trusted` | Untrusted devnet needs explicit `addresses`; devnetName alone throws | `EvoSDK.devnet('mynet', { addresses: ['https://10.0.0.5:1443'] })` |
| `devnet-trusted` | Trusted devnet derives `https://quorums.<name>.networks.dash.org`; override with `quorumUrl` | `EvoSDK.devnetTrusted('paloma', { quorumUrl: 'https://custom.quorums/' })` |
| `option-validation` | Constructor throws: `devnetName` outside `network:'devnet'`, `quorumUrl` without `trusted`, trusted devnet without name/URL | `new EvoSDK({ network: 'devnet', trusted: true })` |
| `explicit-addresses` | `addresses` replace network defaults; in trusted mode they also skip masternode discovery | `EvoSDK.withAddresses(['https://127.0.0.1:1443'], 'local')` |
| `bigint-credits` | Credits, balances, nonces and token amounts are `bigint` | `await sdk.identities.balance(id) // bigint` |
| `ESM-only` | `@dashevo/evo-sdk` is ESM-only (`"type":"module"`, Node >= 18.18); use `import()` from CommonJS | `const { EvoSDK } = await import('@dashevo/evo-sdk');` |
| `wasm-sdk-entrypoints` | `@dashevo/wasm-sdk` exports `.`, `./compressed` (what evo-sdk uses), `./raw`; init via default export | `import init, * as wasm from '@dashevo/wasm-sdk/compressed'; await init();` |
| `wasm-reexport` | evo-sdk re-exports every wasm-sdk and wasm-dpp2 symbol, so classes import from one place | `import { PrivateKey, Identifier, PlatformAddress } from '@dashevo/evo-sdk';` |
| `singleton-wasm-init` | Initialize once; wrap `EvoSDK` in a singleton service that de-duplicates concurrent `initialize()` | `Y:lib/services/evo-sdk-service.ts` |
| `sdk-caching` | Cache one connected SDK per network; drop it on transport errors | `D:src/platform/client.ts` (`sdkCache`, `withConnectedPlatformSdk`) |
| `retry-transport` | Use transport settings with retries and address banning; dash-bridge uses `timeoutMs:40000, retries:2, banFailedAddress:true` | `EvoSDK.testnetTrusted({ settings: { timeoutMs: 40000, retries: 2, banFailedAddress: true } })` |
| `PutSettings` | Per-transition `settings`: `retries`, `timeoutMs`, `waitTimeoutMs`, `userFeeIncrease`, `identityNonceStaleTimeS` | `{ ..., settings: { userFeeIncrease: 10 } }` |
| `PoolingWasm-Standard` | Withdrawals from Platform addresses take `pooling`; use `PoolingWasm.Standard` | `pooling: PoolingWasm.Standard` |
| `core-script-p2pkh` | Withdrawal output script comes from `CoreScript.fromP2PKH(keyHash)` (facade JSDoc says `newP2PKH`, which does not exist) | `CoreScript.fromP2PKH(hash160)` |
| `PlatformAddress-bech32m` | Platform addresses are bech32m (`tdash1...` testnet, `dash1...` mainnet); `PlatformAddressSigner.addKey` derives the address | `const addr = signer.addKey(privateKey);` |
| `address-nonce-input` | `PlatformAddressInput(address, nonce, amount)`; outputs are `PlatformAddressOutput(address, amount)` | `new PlatformAddressInput(addr, 0n, 100000n)` |
| `fee-strategy` | Address transitions take optional `feeStrategy: FeeStrategyStep[]` | `[FeeStrategyStep.deductFromInput(0)]` |
| `broadcast-vs-wait` | `broadcastAndWait` strictly verifies execution; `ExecutionNotProved` means only an affected-state snapshot arrived, so use `waitForAffectedState` | `await sdk.stateTransitions.broadcastAndWait(st)` |
| `prebuilt-broadcast` | Facade ops build, sign, broadcast and wait; for your own transition use `sdk.stateTransitions.broadcastStateTransition` (README says `broadcast`, which does not exist) | `await sdk.stateTransitions.broadcastStateTransition(st, settings)` |
| `token-id-from-contract` | Token IDs are derived; never hard-code | `await sdk.tokens.calculateId(contractId, position)` |
| `token-queries-take-tokenId` | `tokens.contractInfo` takes a token ID, not a contract ID | `sdk.tokens.contractInfo(await sdk.tokens.calculateId(c, 0))` |
| `document-system-fields` | `$id`, `$ownerId`, `$createdAt`, `$updatedAt`, `$revision` are system fields; never set manually | — |
| `where-tuple` | `where` entries are `[field, operator, value]`; `orderBy` entries `[field, 'asc'\|'desc']` | `where: [['$ownerId','==',id]], orderBy: [['$createdAt','desc']]` |
| `contains-containsAny` | PV14 typed arrays: `contains` takes one element; `containsAny` takes 1-100 values and needs `orderBy` on the array | `where: [['hashtags','containsAny',['dash','news']]], orderBy: [['hashtags','asc']]` |
| `aggregates` | `count`/`sum`/`average` return per-group `Map`s; `average` entries are `{ count, sum }` | `await sdk.documents.sum(query, 'amount')` |
| `ranked-queries` | PV14 `ranked`/`having` need an index declaring `rankedCountable/Summable/Averageable`; `limit` required and capped by `EvoSDK.maxRankedLimit()` | `sdk.documents.ranked({ ..., groupBy:'postId', aggregate:{type:'count'}, limit:10 })` |
| `ranked-avg-scale` | Divide ranked `avg` values by `page.valueScale`, never a literal | `Number(entry.value) / Number(page.valueScale)` |
| `ranked-prefix-pins` | Compound ranked index: pin prefixes via `where` (`==`, `contains`, at most one branching `in`, limit `maxPrefixInBranches`); `in` cannot combine with `offset` | `where: [['city','in',['Berlin','Hamburg']]]` |
| `chained-query` | Chained semi-join returns inner + outer docs under one proof; `innerLimit` is required | `sdk.documents.chained({ dataContractId, innerDocumentType:'like', joinProperty:'postId', outerDocumentType:'post', innerLimit:20 })` |
| `composite-query` | One verified round trip for a page plus derived sub-queries | `sdk.documents.composite({ dataContractId, documentType, limit, subQueries })` |
| `pv14-gated` | Ranked, typed arrays, refersTo, encryptedFor, moderation, charters, action fees and new doc-ID derivation need protocol version 14; unpinned SDKs seed at 13 (mainnet/testnet/local) or 14 (devnets) and ratchet up | `sdk.version()` |
| `document-id-pv14` | From PV14 a new document's ID commits to the contract nonce; derive via `DocumentCreateTransition({ document, identityContractNonce })`, `document.setIdForCreation(nonce)` or `Document.generateId` | `P:wasm-dpp2/README.md` |
| `contested-create` | Documents entering a contest (DPNS, charters) state a max fund via `contestFund`; get the minimum with `documents.contestFundToJoin(doc)` | `await sdk.documents.contestFundToJoin(document)` |
| `action-fee-agreement` | Doc types with `actionFees` need `actionFeeAgreement` on create/replace/delete/transfer/purchase/setPrice | `DocumentActionFeeAgreement.forDocumentTypeAction(contract, 'post', 'create', { knownPermille, increaseTolerancePercent: 20 })` |
| `contract-cache-seed` | Seed known contracts to skip fetches, then verify freshness off the critical path | `await sdk.contracts.addKnown(DataContract.fromBase64(b64, true, PlatformVersion.latest()))` |
| `contract-cache-persist` | Fetched contracts are cached in the trusted context; mainnet/testnet persist to `localStorage` key `dash-sdk.contracts.<network>` | `P:js-evo-sdk/README.md` |
| `DPNS-contested` | Check `sdk.dpns.isContestedUsername(label)` before registering; contested names need `contestFund` and masternode voting | `await sdk.dpns.isContestedUsername('alice')` |
| `DPNS-homograph-safe` | Normalize labels with `sdk.dpns.convertToHomographSafe(label)` before availability checks | `await sdk.dpns.convertToHomographSafe(label)` |
| `DPNS-preorder-callback` | `registerName` accepts `preorderCallback(preorderDocument)` to persist the preorder before the domain doc | `registerName({ label, identity, identityKey, signer, preorderCallback })` |
| `identity-keys-query` | `getKeys` request is `{type:'all'}`, `{type:'specific', ...}` or `{type:'search', ...}` | `sdk.identities.getKeys({ identityId, request: { type: 'all' } })` |
| `signing-key-override` | Identity transfer/withdraw accept optional `signingKey`; `PutSettings.stateTransitionCreationOptions` can relax security-level/purpose checks | `{ settings: { stateTransitionCreationOptions: { allowSigningWithAnySecurityLevel: true } } }` |
| `nonce-refresh` | After external nonce changes, force reload before the next transition | `wasm.refreshIdentityNonce(identityId)` |
| `encryptedFor-local` | `sdk.encryptedFor.*` runs locally, reading the `encryptedFor` declaration from the contract | `await sdk.encryptedFor.encrypt({ dataContract, documentTypeName, property, plaintext, senderKey, senderPrivateKey, recipientKey })` |
| `encrypted-error-codes` | Consensus failures reach JS as `error.code`; compare with `DocumentReferenceErrorCode`/`DocumentEncryptionErrorCode` members | `e.code === DocumentEncryptionErrorCode.InvalidEncryptedPropertyShape` |
| `moderation-flow` | Moderation (PV14): owner/moderators ban/suspend/warn with a CRITICAL auth key; settled-document deletion is propose then approve by `actionId` | `sdk.contracts.moderatorDeleteSettledDocument(...)` |
| `contract-update-validate` | `DataContract.validateUpdate` exists only in the standalone wasm-dpp2 build, not in wasm-sdk/evo-sdk | `P:wasm-dpp2/README.md` |
| `shielded-nullifiers` | `shielded.nullifiers` takes 32-byte `Uint8Array`s, else `InvalidArgument` | `await sdk.shielded.nullifiers([n1, n2])` |
| `logging` | Control WASM tracing via constructor `logs` or `EvoSDK.setLogLevel`; accepts levels or EnvFilter strings | `await EvoSDK.setLogLevel('wasm_sdk=debug,rs_dapi_client=warn')` |
| `unproved-mode` | `proofs:false` disables proof requests where supported, but several paths (document fetches) force proofs | `new EvoSDK({ proofs: false })` |
| `legacy-dpp-minification` | `@dashevo/wasm-dpp` consumers must keep class names un-minified in bundlers | `P:wasm-dpp/README.md` |
| `legacy-dpp-load` | Legacy wasm-dpp: `const dpp = await loadDpp()` before use | `P:wasm-dpp/lib/index.ts` |
| `website-docs-version` | evo-sdk-website `AI_REFERENCE.md`/`TYPE_REFERENCE.md` are generated from `@dashevo/evo-sdk@4.1.1`; prefer source for 5.0 shapes | `E:public/AI_REFERENCE.md` |
